# abap2UI5

> Framework for building SAP UI5 applications purely in ABAP - no JavaScript,
> OData or RAP required. One ABAP class per app; the framework renders UI5 XML
> views, binds ABAP data and dispatches events over HTTP roundtrips, keeping
> the app's state in a draft between them. Supports NW 7.02 to ABAP Cloud,
> on-premise and cloud.

If you arrived here from a web search rather than from this repository, the
documentation site publishes its own, and it is the better map of the prose:
https://abap2ui5.github.io/docs/llms.txt — every chapter with a one-line
summary, plus https://abap2ui5.github.io/docs/llms-full.txt for all of it in
one fetch. This file is the map of the CODE.

Two audiences, two entry points:

## Building apps with abap2UI5

**Arriving with older knowledge of abap2UI5?** Most of what was written about
it before 1.143.0 - and so most of what a model remembers - names an API that
has been replaced. If you remember the left side, write the right side:

- `z2ui5_cl_xml_view=>factory( )->shell( )->page( )` (one method per control)
  -> `z2ui5_cl_ui5_view_builder=>factory( )` with `ele` / `tag` / `a` / `end` /
  `stringify`, section 3 of the agent guide. The old class left the framework
  with 1.151.0 and only exists where abap2UI5-ext is installed
- `client->_bind_edit( var )` -> `client->_bind( var )` - one binding, always
  both ways; `_bind_edit` is removed
- `client->view_model_update( )`, `popup_model_update( )` and the like ->
  delete the call; changed bound data is pushed automatically
- a `check_initialized` flag of your own, or `z2ui5_if_app~check_initialized`
  -> `client->check_on_init( )`, with `check_on_navigated( )` and
  `check_on_event( )` as the other arms of one `IF`/`ELSEIF` chain
- `CASE client->get( )-event.` and `get( )-t_event_arg` ->
  `CASE client->get_event( ).` and `client->get_event_arg( )` (the fields
  still exist; the calls are the idiom)
- `client->_event_client( … )` -> `client->follow_up_action( … )`, same
  arguments
- `client->nav_app_leave( client->get_app( client->get( )-s_draft-id_prev_app_stack ) )`
  -> `client->nav_app_leave( )`, which returns to the calling app by itself
- `z2ui5_cl_pop_to_confirm`, `z2ui5_cl_pop_to_select` and the other built-in
  `z2ui5_cl_pop_*` -> `z2ui5_cl_popup_to_confirm`, `z2ui5_cl_popup_to_select`,
  … of the popups addon (below) - a separate install, like every addon
- `z2ui5_cl_util=>…` -> not part of the framework any more and no API for
  apps; write the few lines yourself or copy them from
  [abap-util](https://github.com/abap-util/abap-util)

Every replaced name, with old and new code side by side:
[Deprecations](https://abap2ui5.github.io/docs/resources/deprecations.html),
machine-readable as
[deprecations.json](https://abap2ui5.github.io/docs/api/deprecations.json).

- [app-template](https://github.com/abap2UI5/app-template): starter repo with
  the validation gates, CI and agent setup preconfigured - begin here
- [Claude Code plugin](plugin/README.md): the four agent skills, the
  commands `/abap2ui5:new-app`, `check`, `add-ai`, `find-sample` and
  `explain`, an `abap2ui5-reviewer` subagent, a lint-on-edit hook and the
  MCP server in two commands - `/plugin marketplace add abap2UI5/abap2UI5`,
  then `/plugin install abap2ui5@abap2ui5`. The MCP server alone, without
  the skills: `claude mcp add abap2ui5 -- npx --yes -p @abap2ui5/mcp-server abap2ui5-mcp`
- [Agent guide: building apps](docs/agents/building-apps.md): self-contained
  offline reference - app template, lifecycle, view builder, binding, events,
  popups, navigation, validation tooling
- [Client API contract](src/02/z2ui5_if_client.intf.abap): every method an app
  can call, with inline documentation
- [Client API index](docs/agents/client-api.md): every method's signature and
  one paragraph on what it is for, generated from the contract - read this
  for a signature, the contract for the reasoning
- [Client API reference](https://abap2ui5.github.io/docs/resources/api.html):
  the same contract as a generated, searchable page — also fetchable as
  [client-api.json](https://abap2ui5.github.io/docs/api/client-api.json)
- [App interface](src/02/z2ui5_if_app.intf.abap): the one interface an app implements
- [View builder](src/02/z2ui5_cl_ui5_view_builder.clas.abap): generic 1:1 UI5 XML builder
- [Hello world](src/01/04/z2ui5_cl_ui5_app_hi_world.clas.abap): smallest complete
  app - the full shape, with a model and an event dispatcher, is the template
  in section 2 of the agent guide
- [Rendered documentation](https://abap2ui5.github.io/docs/): the human docs site
- [samples](https://github.com/abap2UI5/samples): the curated example apps,
  one class each. [SAMPLES.md](https://github.com/abap2UI5/samples/blob/main/SAMPLES.md)
  lists every one of them with the words to search it by — ask it whether a
  sample already exists before writing an app from scratch
- [samples-controls](https://github.com/abap2UI5/samples-controls) (formerly
  ai-demokit): 622 gate-verified ports of the official UI5 demo kit samples,
  plus CAPABILITIES.md (what abap2UI5 can express)
- [samples-stack](https://github.com/abap2UI5/samples-stack) (formerly
  samples-ext): abap2UI5 combined with OData, RAP, WebSockets, the Fiori
  Launchpad and more
- [Addons](https://abap2ui5-addons.github.io/): finished pieces in
  repositories of their own under
  [abap2UI5-addons](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons), each installed with
  abapGit next to abap2UI5 - look there before building a dialog, a table
  layout, a selection screen or a lock by hand. The map for agents is
  https://abap2ui5-addons.github.io/llms.txt, and
  https://abap2ui5-addons.github.io/addons.json lists every addon with
  `useWhen`, `entryPoints` and `dependsOn`. The ones an app calls from code:
  - [popups](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons/popups): confirm, inform,
    select, decide, input, file upload and download, table, messages, range
    and value help dialogs - `z2ui5_cl_popup_to_confirm`, `_to_inform`,
    `_to_select`, `_to_decide`, `_get_values`, `_file_ul`, `_file_dl`,
    `_table`, `_messages`, `_get_range`, `_value_help`; each a `factory( )`
    handed to `client->nav_app_call( )`. Needs layout-management
  - [layout-management](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons/layout-management):
    tables and forms the user lays out and saves as variants -
    `z2ui5_cl_layo_manager`, `z2ui5_cl_layo_pop`
  - [range-filter](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons/range-filter):
    select-options with saved variants, from a table name or your data -
    `z2ui5_cl_sel_multisel`, `z2ui5_cl_sel_multisel_pop`
  - [lock-manager](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons/lock-manager): an SAP
    lock held across roundtrips - `z2ui5_cl_lock_manager=>request( )`
  - [abap-cloud-gui](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons/abap-cloud-gui): the
    classic report model, selection screen, list and ALV - a subclass of
    `z2ui5_cl_cgui_report`
  - [rap-ext](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons/rap-ext): list report,
    object page and value help from a CDS view -
    `z2ui5_cl_rap_list_report` and its siblings (experimental)
  - [custom-controls](https://github.com/abap2UI5-addons/custom-controls):
    signature pad, charts, barcodes, editors - one `z2ui5_cl_cci_*` class per
    control

  In a project made from app-template, `npm run add-addon -- <repo>` adds the
  addon and what it depends on to `abaplint.jsonc`, so the lint gate resolves
  its classes instead of reporting "Class ... not found"
- [abap2UI5-linter](https://github.com/abap2UI5/linter): static +
  headless-render checks for app view code (CLI, GitHub Action, VS Code)
- [mcp-server](https://github.com/abap2UI5/mcp-server): MCP server with the
  deploy -> build -> run -> screenshot loop, no SAP system needed

## Developing the framework itself

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the complete briefing for changes to this
  repository - architecture, layered design, coding rules, validation
- [Repository map](docs/agents/repository-map.md): what lives in which
  directory outside src/ - app/, node/, tools/, frontend/, .github/
  and every gate script in it
- [CI/CD workflows](docs/agents/ci-workflows.md): what every workflow does,
  grouped by purpose, and the two deliveries of the transpiled backend
- [Architecture seams](docs/agents/architecture-seams.md): the swappable
  draft store and serializer (for hosts that are not an SAP system), the
  roundtrip monitor (z2ui5_if_ui5_monitor, for usage/performance/error
  logging) and the codepage fallback a view render survives
- [Design decisions](docs/agents/decisions.md): what was proposed, measured
  and declined - AGENTS.md keeps only the one-line prohibitions
- [API-snapshot exceptions](docs/agents/api-snapshot-exceptions.md): the
  recorded times the public-API snapshot was regenerated over a change
- [JS unit spec inventory](docs/agents/test-inventory.md): which bundle/webapp
  module has which spec under node/tests/
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): human contributor workflow
- [abaplint.jsonc](abaplint.jsonc): machine-checked code standards
